questions.text: Discuss the Characteristics of early childhood. Elucidate the physical and psychosocial development in early childhood.
Explain cognitive development during adolescence with special emphasis on Piaget's theoretical approach.
Describe development during adult years. Compare the stage theories and the contextual approach to development during this period.
Critically analyse Piaget's and Kohlberg's theories of moral development during school years.
Discuss the concept of growth and development. Describe its major areas.
Describe the characteristics and major adjustments during infancy.
Differentiate between self-concept and self-esteem in adolescents and elucidate the signs of negative self-concept in them.
Discuss the causes of learning disability and suggest remedial programmes for it.
Elucidate the ageing issues and challenges in late adulthood.
